requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Experience developing backend services, APIs, data-processing systems, or distributed software.
Experience with Python and Python-based systems.
Experience with software development fundamentals, including design, testing, debugging, code review, version control, and CI/CD practices.
Experience working with structured or semi-structured event data, logs, metrics, or telemetry.
Experience building data ingestion, parsing, normalization, enrichment, or correlation pipelines.
Familiarity with distributed storage, data lakes, warehouses, streaming systems, or event-driven architectures.
Experience with security operations, SIEM, TDIR, threat detection, threat hunting, triage, or incident response workflows.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, embeddings, knowledge graphs, or model integrations.
Experience designing evaluations for AI/ML systems, including quality, safety, latency, cost, and user trust.
Experience with cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, observability, or production service operations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or agentic engineering tools.
Experience developing secure, privacy-conscious, and resilient enterprise software.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering and non-engineering disciplines.
Ability to learn security operations concepts and apply feedback from security experts to software designs.
